notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

Modified certain UI elements:

Stage numbers are now displayed for easy identification.
Acquired crowns are relocated to the top left corner.

Addressed collision bugs and made anticipated fixes.
Implemented changes to the save system.

notes.title: Game Level Patch
notes.content: Now, the time to slow down when clicking is a little slower, so the difficulty has been alleviated overall.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

Fixed an issue where the gravity effect would still be applied upon respawning if the player died during the activation of gravity effects in Stage 2.

Added a new feature: the addition of an "Exit" button for improved user convenience.

We appreciate your feedback and are committed to providing a seamless gaming experience.
